subject.title: refactor(memory): move QMD coordination to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public lease API and clean-restart-only QMD upgrade boundary after live contention and upgrade proof is added?
rationale: The implementation deliberately removes the shipped file-lock coordination path, adds persistent schema and public Plugin SDK surface, and makes mixed-version operation unsupported; tests cannot decide whether that operator contract is acceptable.

options.title: Prove and land the design
options.body: Require live two-process QMD contention, lease-loss or process-pause handling, clean upgrade restart, and backup/restore evidence before merging the current architecture.

options.title: Accept the documented cutover
options.body: Merge with test-only evidence and explicitly own the requirement that operators restart every process before QMD resumes after upgrade.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Pause the PR and keep the lease capability internal to memory-core until maintainers separately approve a general Plugin SDK lease API.

recommendation.title: Prove and land the design
recommendation.body: Require live two-process QMD contention, lease-loss or process-pause handling, clean upgrade restart, and backup/restore evidence before merging the current architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and recent architecture work span all affected ownership boundaries, including memory-core, Plugin SDK, persistent databases, Doctor, snapshots, and backups.
